problem_statement: V2I was locked before its first readout and may not be retuned. Its shared possession regime increased emergent football key mass modestly but historical spread prediction and calibration remained inadequate. V2J changes architecture before any V2J result: game- and team-specific PIT-safe pregame strength conditions drive scoring probabilities, while a training-only shared game scoring-efficiency regime creates common environment dependence. V2I observed errors may motivate this family change but may not be numerical fitting or selection targets.

pregame_strength_conditioning.role: Condition offense/defense drive scoring logits and possession opportunity before sportsbook prices are applied.

shared_game_environment.fit_policy: Estimate only from prior training games using football event residual state after pregame-strength conditioning.
shared_game_environment.application: One sampled game environment is shared by both teams and may move scoring efficiency jointly while preserving team-specific conditioned strength.

architecture.key_number_policy: No explicit +/-3 or +/-7 target, correction, bonus mass, redistribution, loss term, hyperparameter criterion, or candidate-selection objective is permitted. Key mass is post-fit diagnostic only.

forbidden_inputs: historical signed key-number frequencies as fitting or selection targets
V2H or V2I signed-key residual values as fitting or selection targets
V2I fold outcomes as hyperparameter targets
outer-fold outcomes during fitting or selection
prospective outcomes for candidate selection or tuning

fit_and_selection.selection_objective: Predictive probability loss only; no key-number objective
